idea-plugin.name: Flix
idea-plugin.description:
Flix language support and breakpoint debugging for the wstein/flix-fork Flix compiler build.

Debugging runs on IntelliJ's own JVM debugger rather than a separate debug protocol, so one session covers Flix and every other JVM language in the same process: step from Flix into Java or Kotlin and back, with each language's own breakpoints, source navigation and evaluator.

Completion, diagnostics and hover come from the same flix lsp language server the official VS Code extension downloads — no reimplementation — via LSP4IJ's LSP client.

Debugging requires the Java plugin, so it is unavailable in IDEs that do not bundle one. Language support is not: that part loads everywhere.
